title: Timed mock: chat system

kcs.statement: In the chat mock, requirements pin down 1:1 vs group chat, online/offline delivery, read receipts and history retention before any design is drawn.
In the chat mock, the estimate derives concurrent connections, messages per second and storage per year, and uses connections to size the connection server fleet.
In the chat mock, the delivery path is narrated end to end: sender socket, persist, sequence number, registry lookup, recipient socket or push notification, acknowledgement.
In the chat mock, the failure review covers connection server crashes, message store partitions and duplicate delivery after retries, with a fix for each.

problem_ideas: Core activity: in one uninterrupted 45-minute attempt, submit a complete answer for 1B users, 100M concurrent, covering all seven rubric areas; then score each area in a separate review.
Variant: add 'last seen' presence for 1B users. Estimate the heartbeat load.
Interviewer pushback: 'Why not long polling?' Answer it in 60 seconds.
Variant: groups of 1,000 members. Rework the fan-out.
Spend 5 minutes on the deep dive: message ordering across devices.
Write the bottleneck list from your diagram in 3 minutes.
